title: Rabbi David Tawil: Understanding the Amida- " Birkat Kohanim (Part 1)"

chapters.title: Introduction to Birkat Kohanim
chapters.about: Context of the blessing within the Amidah

chapters.title: Akirat Raglayim
chapters.about: The requirement for Kohanim to move toward the platform

chapters.title: Netilat Yadayim for Kohanim
chapters.about: Ritual hand washing and its connection to the Beit HaMikdash

chapters.title: Removing shoes and the status of a Halal
chapters.about: Reasons for removing shoes and defining a Halal

chapters.title: Prohibition against staring
chapters.about: Why one should not look at the Kohanim during the blessing

chapters.title: Disfigurement and customs
chapters.about: Performing Birkat Kohanim with a mum and the Tallit custom

summary: Rabbi Tawil explains the procedural laws and significance of Birkat Kohanim, focusing on the requirements for Kohanim to prepare and perform the blessing during the Amidah. He discusses the Halakhot regarding Netilat Yadayim, the removal of shoes, and the prohibition against staring at the Kohanim during the service. The class also addresses common customs, such as covering children with a Tallit, and clarifies the status of a Halal.
questions: Why do Kohanim wash their hands before Birkat Kohanim?
Is it necessary for a Kohen to remove his shoes before blessing the congregation?
Why are we not supposed to look at the Kohanim while they are blessing?
What is a Halal and how does it affect a Kohen's status?
Is there a source for the custom of putting a Tallit over children during Birkat Kohanim?
